contexts.text: In proportion as riches have in them spiritual good; that is... the good of our country, or the public good... they are good.
What those become who are in no love... towards the public...
Man is in the love of self when in what he thinks and does, he does not regard the neighbour, thus not the public...
All the forms of government (in Heaven) agree in this: that they regard the public good as the end; and, therein, the good of each one...
With all such, the public good is in their mouths, but their own good in their hearts.
These supreme ones are chosen from those whose heart is in the public weal.
They seek dominion with the end that they may perform uses to the public, and to private persons.
That there are duties of charity, some public... General article. TCR 430.
It is not allowable to say these things in public, lest they should come into thought to man.
He said that all others regard themselves and not the public. (He was told) that he was a thief... wanting to plunder the public for the sake of self... SE 4363:end.
There are some who do not live for any use... caring nothing for public things... (Their correspondence.)
The public and non-public libraries in Heaven.
The life of the love of use is the life of public love, etc.

The essence of uses is the public good; through the public good in the most general sense with the Angels is the good of the whole Heaven; in a less general one, the good of the Society; and in a particular one, the good of a fellow-citizen.
2. The neighbour in a wide sense is the Common, or public, DWis 4.
